subject: CS231
filterSummary: Filtered out videos with low relevance (<5), incorrect audio language (e.g., Hindi, Urdu, Tamil, Telugu), duration outside 60–3600s range, short/entertainment clips, and duplicate channels per topic. Selected the best English and Arabic videos covering each of the five hardest topics; one topic (Huntington Postulates) lacked suitable Arabic candidates and was omitted. No Arabic video for Huntington Postulates was found with adequate relevance and language match.
